pattern: SELECT [A-Za-z]+ FROM [A-Za-z]+ WHERE IN \((SELECT [A-Za-z]+ FROM Pets WHERE PetType = 'cat'\)
correction: Join the necessary tables and use subqueries for filtering pets by type, then intersect the results.

metadata.description: This rule identifies SQL queries that incorrectly use subqueries to filter pet types and suggests a correction by joining the necessary tables and using subqueries for filtering pets.
